video_title: Thanasis Antetokounmpo & Milwaukee Brewers LEGEND Nyjer Morgan Swap Crazy Pro Sports Stories

quotes.speaker: Nyjer Morgan
quotes.summary_phrase: Nyjer Morgan on transitioning from professional baseball to real estate investing
quotes.excerpt: Once I was done retiring, I got into the Airbnb business and my wife, she's a realtor.
quotes.quote: Once I was done retiring, I got into the Airbnb business and my wife, she's a realtor as well. We actually do hard money loans as well too. I started getting into the hard money loans and stuff like that. We have a bunch of investors where, if anybody that doesn't have the financial credit and they need an opportunity to refinance their house, then that's when the hard money comes into play and we go do that.

quotes.speaker: Nyjer Morgan
quotes.summary_phrase: Nyjer Morgan explains his transition into the car rental business
quotes.excerpt: I ended up meeting another gentleman by the name of Kel King, the car rental king.
quotes.quote: It was a cousin of mine, IDP Enterprise out there in Dallas, Texas. He started renting his cars out. I started following him, touched back with him, and basically I ended up meeting another gentleman by the name of Kel King. And when I met Kel King, the car rental king, I bought his mentorship, took it off, and went to another level and now I'm on my way to 100 vehicles.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Thanasis Antetokounmpo on the importance of financial literacy for young athletes
quotes.excerpt: Once you get to the six figures, seven figures, it becomes only about financial literacy.
quotes.quote: To me, it's insane because once you get to the six figures, seven figures, it becomes only about financial literacy and it becomes only about you getting better and investing in yourself and all this other stuff. Forget about 100 and 200 and 300 and 400. I think a lot of people kind of tend to go for the lifestyle and say that's what comes with it, which is okay. You're not supposed to take it to your grave.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Thanasis Antetokounmpo recalls the emotional moment he was called up to the NBA
quotes.excerpt: They told me I was called up to the NBA... and I started crying.
quotes.quote: They called me in the office and said, 'Hey Thanasis, you're going to be with the team, just want to let you know, congratulations.' And I started crying. Now mind you, it's my second year of my brother on the Bucks. He had a good year with the Bucks the first year, second year he's kind of like, and then you know, I'm getting my chance in the NBA.

quotes.speaker: Nyjer Morgan
quotes.summary_phrase: Nyjer Morgan on the evolution of sports science and athlete training
quotes.excerpt: When we were playing, I felt like we were the guinea pigs.
quotes.quote: When we were playing, I felt like we were the guinea pigs because they were getting all the science technology when G2 first came out, the G2 drinks. A lady by the name of Leslie Bonci, she actually worked for Gatorade, I don't know if she still does, but she used to come in, talk to the players, letting us know about the nutrition, how to stay hydrated, recovery, and all that good stuff. So there was no NormaTec, there was no, what is it, the game ready, the ice machine. There was none of that.
